method.source_inspection: All five original screenshots were viewed at original detail before transcription.
method.independence: No operator reference JSON, existing reference lock, parent reasoning, or parent values were consulted.
method.accuracy_label: independent AI observation; not human gold accuracy
method.scope: Readable HUD fields and main-viewport observations only; minimap and roster icons are excluded from viewport counts.
method.unreadable_policy: Unreadable, absent, or semantically unresolved fields are null or explicitly marked uncertain; no intent, psychological state, match patch, or time-sequence inference is assigned.

limitations: Garen has no readable numeric resource field in this source; resource fields are null.
